Method of Attack: Heap buffer overflow in Philips Hue Bridge model 2.x to execute arbitrary code
Bombarding the bridge with large amounts of data to trigger the overflow
Installing malware on the control bridge
Using known exploits such as EternalBlue to jump to other systems on the network
Deploying malware types including backdoor, spyware, info-stealer, cryptocurrency miner, ransomware
Impacted Systems: Devices on the same local network connected to the Philips Hue Bridge
Attack Vector: Malicious firmware installed on Philips Hue smart bulbs
Remote exploitation of heap buffer overflow vulnerability in Philips Hue Bridge
